title: Zephyr: receipt status propagation
description: Track and propagate receipt status to observers
close_reason: Implemented monotonic QUEUED->SENT/FAILED transport status propagation, authenticated receipt correlation, READ-before-DELIVERED rejection, idempotent duplicate and stale/conflict/terminal replay rules, unknown-time timestamp semantics, atomic change hooks, and bounded /msg/sent Observe registration/initial/notification behavior. Sent encoding now reports only actually encoded bounded entries. QEMU ACK/propagation 10/10, sent 8/8, inbox 5/5.
